description: (needs account token) Puts the previous version of a site back online (the version kept by the last deploy). Doing it again restores the version that was replaced. confirm=true applies it. Refused for a suspended or inactive site. Does not charge.

confirm.description: True applies the change. False leaves it unchanged and the reply describes what would change.

site.description: The address of the site, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.

name: rollback_site
title: Roll back site
